cases.title: Verify initial page load buttons and LCM button click behavior
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, 'lcm-button' and 'hcf-button' are visible. Clicking 'lcm-button' slides in the 'resultboxLcm' form and hides the 'resultboxHcf' form.

cases.title: Verify HCF button click behavior and toggle functionality
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'hcf-button' displays the 'resultboxHcf' form and hides 'resultboxLcm'. Test multiple consecutive clicks to ensure HCF form visibility toggles correctly while LCM form remains hidden.

cases.title: Verify LCM form inputs and edge case handling
cases.description: Verify the visibility of the LCM form on load and test inputting positive integers, zero, negative integers, identical numbers, and non-numeric validation into 'lcm-num1-input' and 'lcm-num2-input'.

cases.title: Verify HCF form inputs and edge case handling
cases.description: Verify that clicking 'hcf-button' reveals the HCF form and that input fields 'hcf-num1-input' and 'hcf-num2-input' correctly accept valid integers, identical numbers, and zeros with accurate reflection.

cases.title: Verify LCM calculation, result display, and parity opacity indicators
cases.description: Verify that clicking the LCM 'Calculate' button computes the correct LCM, displays it in 'lcm-result-display', leaves the result unchanged if fields are empty, and updates 'lcm-even-display' and 'lcm-odd-display' opacities.

cases.title: Verify HCF calculation, formatted result output, and parity opacity indicators
cases.description: Verify that entering valid inputs in HCF form and clicking 'hcf-submit-button' displays the formatted result 'HCF of [num1] and [num2] is [result]' in 'hcf-result-display', and correctly adjusts opacities for 'hcf-even-display' and 'hcf-odd-display'.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements properly without leaving any untestable gaps, and have no confirmed blockers.
All requirements and cases are logically consistent, well-defined, and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis:
e2edev_bench_63-R-1: Testable behaviors include checking for the existence of 'lcm-button' and 'hcf-button' on page load, and verifying that clicking 'lcm-button' smoothly slides in the 'resultboxLcm' form via slow animation while simultaneously hiding the 'resultboxHcf' form. Boundaries: Initial page load state and click event transitions. Normal path: Clicking 'lcm-button' correctly toggles visibility. Abnormal/Ambiguous path: Rapid successive clicks on 'lcm-button'. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-2: Testable behaviors include clicking 'hcf-button' to slide toggle 'resultboxHcf' and slide up 'resultboxLcm'. Boundaries: Multiple consecutive clicks. Normal path: Single click reveals HCF form and hides LCM form. Abnormal path: Double consecutive clicks on 'hcf-button' result in the HCF form being hidden; LCM form remains hidden across all click counts. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-3: Testable behaviors include inputting numbers into 'lcm-num1-input' and 'lcm-num2-input' and checking default visibility of the LCM form on page load. Boundaries: Positive integers, zero, negative integers, identical numbers, and non-numeric inputs. Normal path: Valid numbers persist and display accurately. Abnormal path: Non-numeric inputs are rejected, leaving fields empty or showing an error message. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-4: Testable behaviors include inputting values into 'hcf-num1-input' and 'hcf-num2-input' after revealing the form via 'hcf-button'. Boundaries: Same numbers, zero, valid integer inputs. Normal path: Input values accurately reflect in fields. Abnormal path: Handling of invalid inputs or attempting to interact before revealing the form. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-5: Testable behaviors include clicking the LCM 'Calculate' button, computing the LCM, displaying the result in 'lcm-result-display', and adjusting opacity of 'lcm-even-display' and 'lcm-odd-display'. Boundaries: Empty input fields. Normal path: Valid positive integer inputs compute correct LCM and parity. Abnormal path: Either input field being empty leaves the result area unchanged. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-6: Testable behaviors include clicking 'hcf-submit-button' after entering valid positive integers into HCF inputs, displaying the formatted result 'HCF of [num1] and [num2] is [result]' in 'hcf-result-display', and setting opacity on 'hcf-even-display' and 'hcf-odd-display' based on parity. Boundaries: Even vs. odd HCF results. Normal path: Even HCF sets 'hcf-even-display' to full opacity (1) and 'hcf-odd-display' to reduced opacity (0.5), and vice versa for odd HCF. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-7: Testable behaviors include triggering calculation via 'lcm-submit-button', verifying output format in 'lcm-result-display', and dynamic opacity adjustment for 'lcm-even-display' (opacity 1 for even, 0.5 for odd) and 'lcm-odd-display' (opacity 1 for odd, 0.5 for even). Boundaries: Exact opacity values (1 vs 0.5) based on numeric result parity. Normal path: Correct dynamic updates post-calculation. 

e2edev_bench_63-R-8: Testable behaviors include opening the HCF section via 'hcf-button', inputting values, submitting via 'hcf-submit-button', and checking parity-based opacity for 'hcf-even-display' and 'hcf-odd-display'. Boundaries: Normal distinct numbers and edge-case identical numbers. Normal path: Proper calculation and opacity mapping for both even and odd HCF outcomes.
